title: Self-Contained Binary
description: Self-Contained Binary is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Ships as one binary with nothing else required. The build statically links everything; the binary runs on a bare machine. It takes source and produces binary. Tunable parameters: static. Guarantee: the binary never needs a package manager.

fields.mechanism: The build statically links everything; the binary runs on a bare machine.
fields.guarantees: the binary never needs a package manager

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Bare Boot
description: Bare Boot is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Boots from power-on with no operating system beneath. The core includes its own drivers for disk, console, and clock. It takes hardware and produces running core. Tunable parameters: no OS. Guarantee: boot never needs external files.

fields.mechanism: The core includes its own drivers for disk, console, and clock.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Minimal Syscalls
description: Minimal Syscalls is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Uses only a handful of OS calls when an OS is present. The port layer maps to under 20 syscalls; everything else is internal. It takes OS and produces calls. Tunable parameters: <20. Guarantee: the core never assumes unlisted calls.

fields.mechanism: The port layer maps to under 20 syscalls; everything else is internal.
fields.guarantees: the core never assumes unlisted calls

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: No Network Bootstrap
description: No Network Bootstrap is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Installs and runs with no network access ever. All code ships in the binary; no download step exists anywhere. It takes binary and produces running. Tunable parameters: offline. Guarantee: the core never phones home.

fields.mechanism: All code ships in the binary; no download step exists anywhere.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Deterministic Startup
description: Deterministic Startup is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Starts identically every time from the same state. Startup order is fixed and seeded; logs prove the sequence. It takes state and produces boot. Tunable parameters: fixed order. Guarantee: startup never depends on timing.

fields.mechanism: Startup order is fixed and seeded; logs prove the sequence.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Self-Verification
description: Self-Verification is a execution ability in the Zero-Dependency Core Execution database. Verifies its own integrity at every boot. The binary hashes itself and checks against the embedded signature. It takes binary and produces verdict. Tunable parameters: per boot. Guarantee: a failed check always halts.

fields.mechanism: The binary hashes itself and checks against the embedded signature.
